say:1:1029743001:0.text: At Hugin's lively invitation, you all set sail for Cedartown—not long since your last parting.
say:1:1029743001:0.source_cn: 在呼金的邀请下，你们一道来到了分别不久的雪松镇——

say:3:1029743002:1.text: A-ah-ACHOO! S-so cold! What is this place?!
say:3:1029743002:1.source_cn: 啊、啊、啊、啊啾！好、好、好冷，这里好、好、好冷！

choice_prompt:4:1029743002.text: A-ah-ACHOO! S-so cold! What is this place?!
choice_prompt:4:1029743002.source_cn: 啊、啊、啊、啊啾！好、好、好冷，这里好、好、好冷！

say:5:1029743003:1.text: I wasn't expecting the temperature to drop that much over such a short distance! Ugh, I'm freezing.
say:5:1029743003:1.source_cn: 我没想到这么一点路程，气温会变化得这么大……嘶，太冷了。

say:6:1029743004:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, any warming magic on hand? I'll even take a fireball. Just blast me already!
say:6:1029743004:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, any warming magic on hand? I'll even take a fireball. Just blast me already!
say:6:1029743004:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, any warming magic on hand? I'll even take a fireball. Just blast me already!

say:7:1029743005:1.text: I'd rather be roasted than keep shivering like this...
say:7:1029743005:1.source_cn: 我现在宁可被烤熟，也不想再冻着了……

choice_prompt:8:1029743005.text: I'd rather be roasted than keep shivering like this...
choice_prompt:8:1029743005.source_cn: 我现在宁可被烤熟，也不想再冻着了……

say:10:1029743006:0.text: Wait—WHA?! You're not actually gonna throw a fireball, are you?! I was joking!
say:10:1029743006:0.source_cn: 咦？！不会真的扔火球吧！我开玩笑的！
say:10:1029743006:0.male: Wait—WHA?! You're not actually gonna throw a fireball, are you?! I was joking!
say:10:1029743006:0.female: Wait—WHA?! You're not actually gonna throw a fireball, are you?! I was joking!

say:12:1029743008:0.text: After some laughter, you cast a warming spell for Sinbad and the others. With the chill lifted, everyone breathes a sigh of relief.
say:12:1029743008:0.source_cn: 你们说笑了几句，你为辛巴达以及同船的旅客们都施展了防寒...
say:12:1029743008:0.male: After some laughter, you cast a warming spell for Sinbad and the others. With the chill lifted, everyone breathes a sigh of relief.
say:12:1029743008:0.female: After some laughter, you cast a warming spell for Sinbad and the others. With the chill lifted, everyone breathes a sigh of relief.

say:14:1029743009:1.text: Looks like we'd better start listing the local temperatures before boarding passengers...
say:14:1029743009:1.source_cn: 看起来载客之前，还是得写好目的地的气温说明……

say:15:1029743010:1.text: Whether it's Cedartown's snow or the Ashen Wastes' sandstorms, first-timers never see it coming.
say:15:1029743010:1.source_cn: 无论是雪松镇这里的雪和严寒，还是荒角沙漠的风沙，都是没...

say:18:1029743011:1.text: Oho, don't just stand around. Come on, I'll show you around town!
say:18:1029743011:1.source_cn: 嚯嚯，你们就别在这里站着了，我带你们去镇子里逛逛！

choice:8:0:1.text: I can't say no to you.
choice:8:0:1.male: I can't say no to you.
choice:8:0:1.female: I can't say no to you.

say:20:1029743007:1.text: What, my charm doesn't cover the cost? Okay, fine. Can I at least put it on my tab?
say:20:1029743007:1.source_cn: 难道我的信用还不够付款吗——好吧，多半不够，所以记账行不行？

choice:8:1:2.text: Sure, but you'll have to pay up.
choice:8:1:2.male: Sure, but you'll have to pay up.
choice:8:1:2.female: Sure, but you'll have to pay up.
